findings.title: Fertile qualifier stored in label but absent from executable species contract
findings.impact: The source limits the Paulownia entry to fertile Paulownia. Data correctly retains Fertile in common_name_de; native matching reads scientific_name only and the proposed woody_species[]string field cannot express fertility. Both fertile and documented sterile individuals collapse to the same token.
